column1: # Columns: id, kind, owner, pattern, allow, message
# kind: call | string | func | type | import | forbid
# owner: path prefix (relative to server/) that is allowed to define/use the concept
# For import rules, owner is the importer prefix and pattern is a forbidden import substring.
# For forbid rules, owner is the **checked** prefix and pattern is a forbidden call.
#   forbid is the inverse of call: call means "only owner may use"; forbid means
#   "owner must not use, everyone else may". A forbid rule must name a non-empty
#   owner; an empty owner would check no files and never fire.
# An owner of * means every scanned file: use it for rules with no single owner.
# allow exempts path prefixes from an import rule too.
# allow: comma-separated extra path prefixes allowed to use the concept.
# 测试文件按**单文件**逐个登记：以 .go 结尾的前缀只匹配该文件。
# 理由：e2e 需要真实时钟与环境变量；按目录放行会同时放宽该目录的生产代码。
# verify.sh 跑默认口径与 -tests 口径两遍，故这些登记会被实际执行，不是摆设。

column6: load a timezone only in clock or config

column1: # core/retry/budget.go(+test) is in the allow list because BudgetFor maps
# signing contract outcome words, two of which collide with task-state
# literals ("success"). Retry budgets are a different vocabulary.
# core/account is in the allow list because account status shares the word
# "pending" with task status. Account status is a different vocabulary.

column6: use status.TaskState constants; account status comes from core/account

column6: assembly is the composition root; only cmd may import it

column1: # owner and allow are directory prefixes. An owner that ends in .go pins one
# file instead of a directory: cookie.set is the only such rule, and it pins the
# session-cookie writer to cookie.go. The next four rules pin a package, not one
# file: no argon2 call and no token definition outside core/auth.

column6: 会话 cookie 只在 entry/http/router/cookie.go 内写入
argon2 只在 core/auth 内调用
argon2 只在 core/auth 内调用
CSRFToken 只在 core/auth 内定义
NewToken 只在 core/auth 内定义
